name: Default
shortDescription: Usenet meta search that queries many newznab and raw indexers at once and serves one unified API to Sonarr, Radarr and other download tools.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated HYDRA_PASSWORD from the environment settings. It is written only on first start, so change it later under Config > Authorization. You need your own Usenet indexer accounts and their API keys to get search results.
